cohort: The study included 71 Surinamese newborns treated with antibiotics for suspected early onset sepsis (EOS) and 20 control newborns.
finding: At the start of antibiotic treatment, Ang-1 serum levels were lower, and Ang-2 and Ang-2/Ang-1 serum protein ratios were higher in newborns with blood culture positive EOS than in controls, with Ang-1 further decreasing after 48-72 hours in positive cases.
